title: Apple reveals new AI architecture built around Google Gemini models
summary: Apple has announced a new AI architecture leveraging Google Gemini models, marking a significant strategic partnership between the two tech giants. This move positions Apple to compete more effectively in the AI space without building foundation models from scratch.
problem_solved: Addresses Apple's need for competitive AI capabilities by partnering with Google rather than developing expensive in-house foundation models.
why_valuable: This collaboration represents a major shift in AI industry dynamics, combining Apple's hardware ecosystem with Google's advanced AI models to deliver enhanced AI experiences to consumers.
